name: Fungal Stalker 2

inventory.name: Barbed Tendril
inventory.desc: Reach 10 ft. Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit. Hit: 6 (1d8+2) piercing damage.

inventory.name: Fungal Hide
inventory.desc: Natural armor. Combines with Dexterity to reach AC 12.

notes: A skittering, four-legged fungal growth that camouflages against giant mushroom stalks and lashes out with barbed, root-like tendrils. Not intelligent — just territorial and hungry. Also has climb speed 20 ft. Resists poison damage; immune to blinded and poisoned. Blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this). Suggested quantity: 3-4 for a 5-6 PC level 3 party.

customFeatures.name: Spore Camouflage
customFeatures.desc: While within a mushroom-heavy area, the stalker has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide.

customFeatures.name: Choking Spores (Recharge 5-6)
customFeatures.desc: Each creature within 10 feet of the stalker must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned until the end of its next turn.
